# Vendored: Open Data Contract Standard JSON Schema

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **File** | `odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json` |
| **Version** | ODCS v3.1.0 |
| **Source** | https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard/blob/main/schema/odcs-json-schema-v3.1.0.json |
| **Retrieved** | 2026-08-25 |
| **License** | Apache License 2.0 |
| **JSON Schema draft** | 2019-09 |

Vendored unmodified so `validate_contract.py` runs offline and so the version a contract is
checked against is pinned and reviewable, rather than shifting whenever upstream publishes.

`additionalProperties: false` is set at the root and `unevaluatedProperties: false` throughout —
this is what makes v3.1.0 strict, and it is why an invented field is a hard error rather than a
tolerated extension. Anything genuinely outside the standard belongs in `customProperties`.

## Upgrading

Do not edit this file. To move to a newer ODCS release: add the new schema file alongside this
one, update the pinned version in `references/odcs.md` and its date stamp, change the default in
`validate_contract.py`, and re-run the contract fixtures. Keeping the old schema means contracts
pinned to `apiVersion: v3.1.0` still validate against what they were written for.
